name: redact-pdf-ai
description: Redact or anonymize PDFs, scans and screenshots on your machine before an AI or anyone else sees them. Black boxes, or consistent [Person 1] tags that keep the document readable, with the real names put back locally afterwards.

api_key.title: Redact PDF AI API key
api_key.description: Create one after signing up at redact-pdf.ai/sign-up. Optional: without it only the keyless try_demo tool works, which redacts the first page of a real file. A free account gets its first document (up to 5 pages) in full, no card.
